It is almost impossible to get an appointment on time. Even when you go there in person, the staff always say they are fully booked. However, when you look around, the staff do not appear busy at all and often seem to be chatting or sitting together. It feels like patients are not being taken seriously.

In urgent situations, they simply tell you to go to the hospital. But when you go to the hospital, they advise you to check with your GP first unless you are unconscious. This puts patients in a very frustrating and stressful position, going back and forth without receiving proper care.

Not all medical problems are visible. Some conditions are internal and require proper examination and tests. You cannot “show” internal pain or hidden symptoms without being properly checked by a doctor. I am personally struggling with several internal health issues that are not visible, and when I asked for help, I was told there are no appointments available until next month.

The lack of urgency, empathy, and proper patient care is very concerning. Patients deserve to be listened to and treated with respect, especially when dealing with health problems that may not be immediately visible.
